paper_title: Gated Attention for Large Language Models Non-linearity, Sparsity, and   Attention-Sink-Free
caption: Proportion of SDPA output values below threshold after gating (Left: 1e-2, Right: 1e-3). We also include sparsity measurements obtained by multiplying the average gating score with pre-gating hidden states.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: The chart illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output values across layers for a threshold of 1e-3, comparing three metrics: sparsity ratio before gating, sparsity ratio after gating, and sparsity ratio after average gating. The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” represents layer index and is marked with integer values from 0 to 20, with equal spacing. The y-axis, labeled “Sparsity Ratio,” is a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.8, with tick marks and labels at intervals of 0.2. The chart contains three lines: a blue dashed line (sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.003), an orange dotted line (sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.126), and a green dashed line (sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.080). The blue line remains near 0.0 across all layers, showing minimal variation. The orange line starts at approximately 0.8 at layer 0, decreases to approximately 0.05 by layer 10, and then remains relatively flat near 0.03 from layer 15 to 20. The green line starts at approximately 0.8 at layer 0, decreases to approximately 0.05 by layer 10, and then remains relatively flat near 0.02 from layer 15 to 20. The orange and green lines are visually similar in shape and magnitude, with the green line consistently below the orange line.
model_annotations.Chinese: This line chart displays the sparsity ratio of SDPA output values for three different conditions across layers, with the threshold specified as 1e-3. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 20, with uniform numerical tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Sparsity Ratio," uses a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.8, with uniform numerical tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The chart contains three lines: a blue dashed line with circular markers representing the "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.003"; an orange dotted line with circular markers representing the "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.126"; and a green dashed line with circular markers representing the "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.080". The blue line remains nearly constant at a low value near 0.0 throughout the layer range. The orange line starts at approximately 0.8, decreases sharply to about 0.12 near layer 10, and then fluctuates slightly around 0.05 before rising slightly again near layer 20. The green line starts at approximately 0.8, decreases sharply to about 0.05 near layer 10, and then remains nearly flat near 0.0 for the remaining layers.
model_annotations.English: This line plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output values for three different conditions across layers, with the threshold set to 1e-3. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," is linear and spans from 0 to 20, representing the layer index of the model. The y-axis, labeled "Sparsity Ratio," is linear and ranges from 0.0 to 0.8, indicating the proportion of output values below the specified threshold. Three lines are plotted: a blue dashed line with circular markers representing the "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.003," which remains consistently low, starting near 0.01 and ending near 0.002; an orange dotted line with circular markers for the "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.126," which begins at approximately 0.8, rapidly declines to around 0.1 by layer 5, then continues to decrease more gradually to approximately 0.02 by layer 20; and a green dashed line with circular markers for the "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.080," which starts near 0.8, drops to approximately 0.3 by layer 3, continues to decrease to around 0.02 by layer 10, and then remains relatively flat near 0.01 for the remainder of the layers.
model_annotations.German: The diagram illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output values across layers for a threshold of 1e-3, comparing the sparsity before gating, after gating, and after an average gate. The x-axis represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to 20, with tick marks at regular intervals of 5, and is labeled “Layer”. The y-axis represents the sparsity ratio, ranging from 0.0 to 0.8, with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.2, and is labeled “Sparsity Ratio”. The blue dashed line, labeled “sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.003”, remains nearly flat near 0.0 across all layers. The orange dotted line, labeled “sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.126”, starts at approximately 0.8 at layer 0, decreases sharply to around 0.08 at layer 10, and then fluctuates slightly between approximately 0.02 and 0.06 through layer 20. The green dashed line, labeled “sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.080”, starts at approximately 0.8 at layer 0, decreases to around 0.2 at layer 5, continues decreasing to approximately 0.04 at layer 10, and then fluctuates slightly between approximately 0.02 and 0.04 through layer 20.
